name: ConversationWindow

test_list.description: ConversationWindow exposes message-end boundaries that retain every assistant tool call with all matching tool results as one indivisible group.
ConversationWindow rejects orphan, missing, duplicate, reused, mismatched tool results and tool calls attached to non-assistant messages.
archive_window validates before writing, serializes losslessly under the requested cap, and returns a reference that expands to exactly the original messages with verified integrity.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: Structured conversation history whose tool-call groups must remain complete.

inputs.name: max_bytes
inputs.description: Maximum serialized archive size, capped at 16 MiB.

output_description: Validated complete-group message boundaries, or a typed error for malformed history.
